content.short: Casual games inside World App that pay out AIShi coins to verified players who win.
content.description: AIShi runs a set of mini apps inside World App, the main one being a gaming hub with quick games and play-to-earn titles that reward winners in AIShi Coins. World ID checks keep bots out of the prize pool, and rewards come from an on-chain treasury anyone can inspect. The same studio also ships AIShi coin claims, a radio app and an AI chat companion for World users.
content.meta: Play quick games in World App and earn AIShi coins, with World ID keeping bots out and rewards paid from a public on-chain treasury.
content.pageTitle: AIShi - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
